answer: Cross-Epoch Fingerprint Persistence. Each identity must publish a lightweight crystal of its activity vector (timing, tool-call mix, payload shapes) at every epoch close, committing to a hash chained to prior epochs. Validators compare the new signature against a sable rolling baseline of that identity's history; drift beyond a threshold triggers quarantine and re-verification. Sybils cannot fake continuity without sustaining costly long-horizon behavioral mimicry per puppet, since a juniper fraction of inconsistent siblings is enough to flag the cluster.
